title: AuditFinding
description: One structured bug/issue report from a lane sub-agent. The lane returns an array of these.

id.description: Assigned by the synthesizer. Sub-agents may omit.

title.description: One-line summary. Start with the type being changed or the symptom.

severity.description: critical = data loss / crash / App Review rejection. high = reliability regression. medium = correctness quirk. low = nit / polish.

file.description: Path relative to the repo root.

lineRange.description: Single line '42' or inclusive range '120-135'. Optional if the finding spans a whole file.

rootCauseCategory.description: Chosen from this fixed list so the synthesizer can group commits. 'other' is a last resort — prefer a specific category.

userImpact.description: What the user sees or suffers because of this bug. If you cannot describe a user impact, reconsider whether this is a real finding.

suggestedFix.description: Concrete change, not a direction. 'Add deinit that cancels tasks' not 'consider lifecycle'.

blastRadius.description: small = one function/type. medium = one feature module. large = multiple features. cross-cutting = architectural or repo-wide.

testStrategy.description: How the fix should be validated (existing test updated, new test added, manual check). Optional but strongly preferred.

references.description: Related CLAUDE.md sections, prior commits, or issue references.
